message: The other day, my neighbor's kids were giggling about their mom's emergency kit. "Why do we need all this stuff?" they asked. Well, fast forward to last night when the storm sirens went off, and guess who was rummaging through their pantry for candles? I might have had a little smug smile as I sipped my tea, knowing I had my supplies ready. Sometimes, it feels good to be the one who’s prepared—especially when the winds start howling. 🌪️
